sourceChecks.text: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。
